text:
Sam: CedarBank submitted a SIG intake and asked for a short POC touching tokenized payments + EU-only processing. They've flagged BYOK and retention controls. link: https://files.redwood.example/cedarbank/sig_2026.pdf
DeployBot: Uploaded to secure-bucket://intake/cedarbank/3433300001/sig.pdf (sha256: c3d4...) :white_check_mark:
Cassie (CedarBank): Confirming scope: POC will use tokenized IDs (no PAN), sample dataset provided, EU data residency required. Duration: 7 business days.
Noah (SE): Noted. Need expected qps, latency target, and context length. Hosted + BYOK is possible if legal approves DPA.
Cassie (CedarBank): target p95 < 250ms, steady QPS 5, spikes to 30. context ~1.5k tokens.
Priya (Security): I'll take the CAIQ review. Please upload network diagram and sample token set to s3://redwood-secure/intake/cedarbank/3433300001/ and grant redwood/sec-team + eng-se access. Marking assignment to Priya (Security).
Sam: Can someone draft a quick ballpark for Dedicated vs Hosted w/ BYOK? Need a number to share in the pre-kickoff email.
Noah (SE): Quick back-of-envelope: hosted eval with BYOK (eu-west-1) ~ lower cost but legal gating. Dedicated short rental (2xA10) ~ $4k-7k for the week + support. I'll add a worksheet to the share.
Priya (Security): BYOK + EU-only -> legal + DPA required. Assigning LegalBot for DPA check. I'll start high-risk control pass and flag any blocking items.
LegalBot: DPA required if customer-managed keys or EU-only processing? Yes. Opening legal ticket #LEGAL-912. Will advise on temporary eval terms.
Sam: Scheduling kickoff for Tuesday 11am CET. Attendees: @Noah, @Priya, legal rep, CedarBank contacts. Agenda: scope, dataflow, BYOK onboarding, retention.
Cassie (CedarBank): 11am CET works for us. We'll upload diagrams by EOD.
Priya (Security): Noted. I'll post CAIQ comments before the call and a short checklist of artifacts we need.
DeployBot: Intake ticket #SF-4812 created and linked to thread.
Sam: Thanks all, updating CRM to "security_review" and assigning intake to Priya. :thumbsup:
